description: This file contains Drupal's Field API hooks and documentation, defining how fields, widgets, formatters, and related configurations are altered or extended within the Drupal core module for fields.

methods.name: hook_field_info_alter
methods.description: Alters the default widget for fields of type 'foo'.

methods.name: hook_field_info_entity_type_ui_definitions_alter
methods.description: Modifies UI field definitions, e.g., unsets incompatible field types for 'node' entity type.

methods.name: hook_field_ui_preconfigured_options_alter
methods.description: Sets default formatter for media in entity reference fields to 'entity_reference_entity_view' if options include 'media'.

methods.name: hook_field_storage_config_update_forbid
methods.description: Forbids updates to field storage if it would remove allowed values with existing data.

methods.name: hook_field_widget_info_alter
methods.description: Allows reusing existing widgets for new field types.

methods.name: hook_field_widget_single_element_form_alter
methods.description: Adds CSS class 'my-class' to widget form elements for fields of type 'my_type'.

methods.name: hook_field_widget_single_element_WIDGET_TYPE_form_alter
methods.description: Modifies specific widget forms, e.g., setting autocomplete route.

methods.name: hook_field_widget_complete_form_alter
methods.description: Adds CSS class 'my-class' to the complete widget form.

methods.name: hook_field_widget_complete_WIDGET_TYPE_form_alter
methods.description: Adds CSS class 'my-class' to the complete form of specific widget types.

methods.name: hook_field_formatter_info_alter
methods.description: Allows reusing existing formatters for new field types.

methods.name: hook_field_info_max_weight
methods.description: Returns maximum weight for entity components, e.g., for form or display.

methods.name: hook_field_purge_field_storage
methods.description: Responds when a field storage is purged, e.g., deleting related info from custom tables.

methods.name: hook_field_purge_field
methods.description: Responds when a field is purged, e.g., deleting related info from custom tables.

methods.name: hook_field_type_category_info_alter
methods.description: Modifies or adds custom field type categories.
